During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''captain''' commanded the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Aggressor (Imperial I-class)|''Aggressor'']]. He was forced to deal with [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officer [[Mar Barezz]] during his hunt for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agent [[Tay Vanis]].
